acquisition method: Mass spectrometry analysis was carried out in a data dependent manner with full scans (350–1800 m/z) acquired using an Orbitrap mass analyzer at a mass resolution of 60,000 at 400 m/z in Velos and 120,000 in Elite at 400 m/z.
cleavage agent: Briefly, the protein bands were destained, reduced and alkylated and subjected to in-gel digestion using trypsin.
fractionation method: The digests were resolved by bRPLC method using a gradient of 0 to 100% solvent B (10 mM tetraethylammonium bicarbonate in acetonitrile, pH 8.5) in 50 minutes.
fragmentation method: All the tandem mass spectra were produced by higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) method.
instrument: Peptide samples from in-gel digestion and bRPLC fractionation were analyzed on LTQ-Orbitrap Velos or LTQ-Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometers (Thermo Electron, Bremen, Germany) interfaced with Easy-nLC II nanoflow liquid chromatography systems (Thermo Scientific, Odense, Southern Denmark).
reduction reagent: The samples were lysed in lysis buffer containing 4% SDS, 100 mM DTT and 100 mM Tris pH 7.5.
reduction concentration: The samples were lysed in lysis buffer containing 4% SDS, 100 mM DTT and 100 mM Tris pH 7.5.
